text:
ara: Customer reported double toolcall charge after SDK retry + 504. small amount but reproducible.
lee: logs?
ara: ```
GATEWAY A -> TOOL svc call_id=null status=202 wrote_ledger=true tokens=8
client retries -> GATEWAY B -> TOOL svc status=200 wrote_ledger=true tokens=8
```
matt: problem: we wrote confirmed on 202 path due to an error-handling bug. Also no idempotency key so we can't dedupe.
lee: short fix: treat 202 as provisional only and avoid confirmed write until 200.
matt: medium fix: require X-Tool-Idempotency header from SDKs; server-generated fallback for older SDKs. DB migration: index on (call_id, tool) and dedupe historical confirmed dupes.
ara: Console UX: show merged billing row when duplicate confirmed rows share same call_id and close timestamps within 30s; allow expand to see raw rows.
lee: telemetry: emit metric toolcall.duplicate_confirmed.count and alert if >5/min for any tool.
billing-bot: NOTE: update Billing FAQ: brief dupes possible during rollout; final invoice reconciles.
matt: I'll open the hotfix PR for 202 path and the migration RFC.
ara: thanks — will track in #support-ticket-9982.
